description: Create the feature branch and implement prerender expansion + ISR fallback in edge worker + robots.txt/sitemap endpoints + structured data enhancements + IndexNow integration
steps: Create branch feat/seo-optimization-v2 from current main (7e7a3ab)

PRERENDER EXPANSION: In apps/frontend/scripts/prerender-routes.mjs, change PRERENDER_SUBJECTS_LIMIT default from '50' to '999' (line with `process.env.PRERENDER_SUBJECTS_LIMIT || "50"`). Change PRERENDER_CHAPTERS_PER_SUBJECT default from '6' to '999' (line with `process.env.PRERENDER_CHAPTERS_PER_SUBJECT || "6"`)
In apps/frontend/scripts/build.mjs, raise BUILD_BUDGET_MS default from 12 * 60_000 to 1500000 (25 min). The default calculation is in the BUDGET_MS IIFE near top of file.
In apps/frontend/scripts/prerender-all.mjs, raise STEP_BUDGET_MS default from `8 * 60_000 - 5_000` to 1200000 (20 min). The default is in the STEP_BUDGET_MS IIFE near top of file.

ISR FALLBACK: Create apps/edge/src/routes/isr.ts with: bot detection via User-Agent regex (googlebot, bingbot, gptbot, claudebot, perplexitybot, applebot, etc.), KV cache lookup (key = pathname), on cache hit return cached HTML with appropriate headers, on cache miss proxy to AZURE_BACKEND_URL, cache successful HTML responses in KV with 1-hour TTL, use ctx.waitUntil for async cache writes
Update apps/edge/src/env.d.ts to add ISR_CACHE_KV: KVNamespace to the Env interface
Update apps/edge/wrangler.toml to add ISR_CACHE_KV namespace binding under [env.production.kv_namespaces]

Update apps/edge/src/index.ts to import and integrate ISR handler: add import for handleISR from './routes/isr', add a route check BEFORE the fallback 404 that calls handleISR for non-API, non-asset requests when User-Agent matches bot patterns

ROBOTS.TXT + SITEMAP: Create apps/edge/src/routes/robots.ts exporting a handler that returns robots.txt content allowing Googlebot, GPTBot, Google-Extended, ClaudeBot, Applebot-Extended and blocking CCBot, Bytespider, with Sitemap: https://syrabit.ai/sitemap.xml

Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/seo.py with FastAPI router containing: GET /sitemap.xml (sitemap index pointing to sub-sitemaps), GET /sitemap-static.xml (static pages), GET /sitemap-subjects.xml (subject pages stub), GET /sitemap-chapters.xml (chapter pages stub with deduplication logic)
Register seo router in apps/backend/app/main.py with prefix '/api/v1/seo' and tags=['SEO']
Add robots.txt route in apps/edge/src/index.ts (before the fallback) that calls the robots handler for /robots.txt requests
Add sitemap proxy route in apps/edge/src/index.ts for /sitemap*.xml requests that proxies to the backend

STRUCTURED DATA + INTERNAL LINKING: In apps/frontend/scripts/prerender-routes.mjs, in the renderOne section for subject pages, inject BreadcrumbList JSON-LD (Home > Library > Subject) and Course JSON-LD schema into the HTML head. Also add content-type-aware title formulas: for chapter pages with content_type='mcq' use 'MCQ & Practice Questions' suffix, for 'notes' use 'Complete Notes' suffix, for 'pyq' use 'Previous Year Questions' suffix.

Create apps/frontend/src/components/chapter/RelatedTopicsNav.jsx: A navigation component showing prev/next chapter links and parent subject link using plain <a> tags for crawlability. Props: prevChapter, nextChapter, parentSubject (each with title, href). Render as a nav element with aria-label='Related Topics'.
Update apps/frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.jsx to import and render RelatedTopicsNav below the main content, passing sibling chapter data from the existing findSiblingChapters utility

INDEXNOW INTEGRATION: Create apps/backend/app/api/v1/indexnow.py with POST /indexnow/submit endpoint protected by X-IndexNow-Secret header, accepting a list of URLs and submitting them to IndexNow API in batches of 100
Add INDEXNOW_API_KEY: Optional[str] = None to apps/backend/app/config.py Settings class
Register indexnow router in apps/backend/app/main.py with prefix '/api/v1/indexnow' and tags=['IndexNow']

Create apps/frontend/scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs: Post-deploy script that reads dist/prerender-manifest.json, discovers all prerendered HTML files under dist/, constructs full URLs (https://syrabit.ai/...), and POSTs them in batches to the backend /api/v1/indexnow/submit endpoint

Update .github/workflows/deploy-all.yml: Add an 'indexnow-submit' step in the deploy-frontend job AFTER the 'Deploy to Cloudflare Pages' step that runs node apps/frontend/scripts/indexnow-submit.mjs with INDEXNOW_SECRET env var from secrets
TESTS: Create apps/backend/tests/test_seo.py testing the sitemap endpoints (GET /api/v1/seo/sitemap.xml returns XML, GET /api/v1/seo/sitemap-static.xml returns XML with known static pages)
Create apps/backend/tests/test_indexnow.py testing the indexnow endpoint (POST without secret returns 401/403, POST with valid secret and URLs returns 200)
acceptance_criteria: Branch feat/seo-optimization-v2 exists based on main
apps/edge/src/routes/isr.ts exists with bot detection + KV cache + proxy logic
apps/edge/src/index.ts integrates ISR, robots.txt, and sitemap proxy routes
apps/backend/app/main.py registers seo and indexnow routers
apps/backend/tests/test_seo.py and test_indexnow.py exist and pass
TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) passes for edge package
